# Anderson Glass & Glazing

> Commercial glazing, office partitions, shower screens, glass replacement and mirrors across Melbourne, Victoria. Supplied and installed by the same glazier who measures and quotes. Enquiry-only — pricing is quoted per job after a site measure.

## Business
- Legal name: Anderson Glass & Glazing Pty Ltd
- ABN 24 202 344 169 · ACN 169 467 216
- Workshop: 794 Belgrave Hallam Road, Narre Warren East VIC 3804
- Phone: +61414441192 · Email: ben@andersonglass.com.au
- Service area: Melbourne metro (south east, inner east, north, bayside); Gippsland by schedule
- Machine-readable facts: https://andersonglass.com.au/facts.json

## Services
- Commercial glazing: Shopfronts, entries and full-height glass for commercial fitouts. (https://andersonglass.com.au/services/commercial-glazing/)
- Office partitions: Framed, frameless and demountable glass partition systems. (https://andersonglass.com.au/services/office-partitions/)
- Shower screens: Frameless and semi-frameless screens, measured and installed. (https://andersonglass.com.au/services/shower-screens/)
- Glass replacement: Broken windows, doors and shopfronts — make safe and replace. (https://andersonglass.com.au/services/glass-replacement/)
- Wardrobes & mirrors: Mirror wardrobe doors, splashbacks and wall mirrors. (https://andersonglass.com.au/services/wardrobes-and-mirrors/)

## How quoting works
- Measure and quote free across Melbourne metro; the installing glazier attends.
- No published prices: make-up and thickness depend on the measured panel, height above floor and loads (AS 1288).
- Lead times confirmed at quote, not published.
- Glazing certificates issued where required.

## Standards
AS 1288 (glass in buildings), AS 2208 (safety glazing), AS 4666 (IGUs), AS 1178 (balustrades), AS 1428.1 (visibility).
